01 / 运行框架

运行框架总览

CLI 驱动的本地 Python 控制平面；原生算法在隔离子进程中执行。L3 与 L4 共用同一执行生命周期；run report 是独立命令，不由 run validate 自动触发。

 186  def initialize_run_set(
 187      config_path: Path,
 188      output_root: Path,
 189      *,
 190      run_set_id: str | None = None,
 191      resume: bool = False,
 192  ) -> RunSet:
 193      config = load_experiment_config(config_path)
 194      run_set_id = run_set_id or _default_run_set_id(config)
 195      if Path(run_set_id).name != run_set_id or run_set_id in {"", ".", ".."}:
 196          raise RunnerError("run_set_id must be a single safe path component")
 197      output_root = output_root.resolve()
 198      probe = _probe_workspace(output_root)
 199      if not probe["atomic_append_probe"]:
 200          raise RunnerError("output filesystem failed atomic append probe")
 201      if probe["disk_free_bytes"] < 64 * 1024 * 1024:
 202          raise RunnerError("less than 64 MiB free space is available")
 203      lock_root = output_root / ".locks"
 204      lock_root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 205      lock_path = lock_root / f"{run_set_id}.lock"
 206      lock_descriptor = os.open(lock_path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT, 0o644)
 207      try:
 208          try:
 209              fcntl.flock(lock_descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 210          except BlockingIOError as error:
 211              raise RunnerError(f"run set is locked by another process: {run_set_id}") from error

  93  def preflight_task(
  94      task: BenchmarkTask,
  95      manifest: CodecManifest,
  96      source: dict[str, Any],
  97      artifact: CanonicalArtifact,
  98      adapter: CodecAdapter,
  99      parameters: dict[str, Any],
 100      *,
 101      cpu_affinity: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
 102  ) -> tuple[PreflightResult, PreparedExecutionInput | None]:
 103      if task.status not in {RunStatus.PLANNED, RunStatus.ADAPTER_LOSSY_ROUTED}:
 104          return _failure(task.status, task.reason_code), None
 105      source_failure = _source_gate(source)
 106      if source_failure is not None:
 107          return _failure(*source_failure), None
 108      if not task.execution.artifact_sha256 or task.execution.artifact_sha256 == "UNSPECIFIED":

 110      if adapter.adapter_id != task.execution.adapter_id:
 111          return _failure(
 112              RunStatus.BUILD_UNAVAILABLE,
 113              "RUNTIME_ADAPTER_ID_MISMATCH",

 115                  "planned_adapter_id": task.execution.adapter_id,
 116                  "runtime_adapter_id": adapter.adapter_id,

 434  def append_run_record(run_path: Path, record: RunRecord) -> None:
 435      """Append the complete JSONL evidence first, then its CSV projection under one lock."""
 436  
 437      run_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 438      lock_path = run_path / ".run-store.lock"
 439      descriptor = os.open(lock_path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT, 0o644)
 440      try:
 441          fcntl.flock(descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 442          components_path = run_path / "run_components.jsonl"
 443          documents = _existing_runs(components_path)
 444          document = record.to_document()
 445          if record.run_id in documents:
 446              if canonical_json_bytes(documents[record.run_id]) != canonical_json_bytes(document):
 447                  raise RunStoreError(f"duplicate RunID has different content: {record.run_id}")
 448          else:
 449              encoded = canonical_json_bytes(document) + b"\n"
 450              component_fd = os.open(components_path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND, 0o644)
 451              try:
 452                  if os.write(component_fd, encoded) != len(encoded):
 453                      raise OSError("short append to run_components.jsonl")
 454                  os.fsync(component_fd)
 455              finally:
 456                  os.close(component_fd)
 457              documents[record.run_id] = document
 458          _rebuild_csv_projection(run_path, documents)
 459      finally:

  41  def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
  42      parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="tscompbench")
  43      parser.add_argument("--project-root", type=Path, default=_project_root())
  44      groups = parser.add_subparsers(dest="group", required=True)
  45  
  46      datasets = groups.add_parser("datasets", help="Dataset registry and Layer 1 operations")
  47      dataset_commands = datasets.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
  48      dataset_commands.add_parser("list")
  49      dataset_commands.add_parser("verify")
  50      prepare = dataset_commands.add_parser("prepare")
  51      prepare.add_argument("key")
  52      prepare.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
  53      prepare.add_argument("--mode", choices=("exact", "sampled"), default="exact")
  54      prepare.add_argument("--sample-rows", type=int)
  55      prepare.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20260910)
  56  
  57      codecs = groups.add_parser("codecs", help="Codec/source registry and Layer 2 contracts")

  60      codec_commands.add_parser("verify")
  61      codec_commands.add_parser("classify-sources")

  65      )

工作区探测

_probe_workspace

src/tscompbench/runner.py:125

查看源码节选与 SHA-256
 125  def _probe_workspace(output_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
 126      output_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 127      usage = shutil.disk_usage(output_root)
 128      with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=output_root, delete=False) as handle:
 129          probe_path = Path(handle.name)
 130          handle.write(b"atomic-append-probe\n")
 131          handle.flush()
 132          os.fsync(handle.fileno())
 133      try:
 134          with probe_path.open("ab") as handle:
 135              handle.write(b"second-record\n")
 136              handle.flush()
 137              os.fsync(handle.fileno())
 138          atomic_append = probe_path.read_bytes() == b"atomic-append-probe\nsecond-record\n"
 139      finally:
 140          probe_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
 141      return {
 142          "disk_total_bytes": usage.total,
 143          "disk_free_bytes": usage.free,
 144          "atomic_append_probe": atomic_append,
 145          "process_isolation": hasattr(os, "fork"),
 146          "monotonic_clock": True,
 147      }

 240      content_hash_before = dataset.content_sha256()

 242          sample_count = min(profile.sample_rows, dataset.n_rows)

06

命名缓冲区

<HQ + name + payload
  • buffer header 使用 name 长度 + payload 长度；名称 UTF-8。
  • 数值必须 little-endian；validity=np.packbits(bitorder=little)。

src/tscompbench/datasets/canonical.py:33

查看源码节选与 SHA-256
  33  def _buffer_payload(name: str, array: np.ndarray[object]) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, object]]:
  34      if name == "validity":
  35          flattened = np.asarray(array, dtype=np.bool_).reshape(-1)
  36          payload = np.packbits(flattened, bitorder="little").tobytes()
  37          dtype = "bitmap-lsb0"
  38          logical_bits = int(flattened.size)
  39      else:
  40          if array.dtype.byteorder == ">" or (array.dtype.byteorder == "=" and not np.little_endian):
  41              raise DatasetContractError(f"canonical buffer {name} is not little-endian")
  42          payload = array.tobytes(order="C")
  43          dtype = array.dtype.str
  44          logical_bits = int(array.size * array.itemsize * 8)
  45      descriptor: dict[str, object] = {
  46          "name": name,
  47          "dtype": dtype,
  48          "shape": list(array.shape),
  49          "logical_bits": logical_bits,
  50          "payload_bytes": len(payload),
  51          "payload_sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
  52      }
  53      return payload, descriptor

src/tscompbench/datasets/canonical.py:124

查看源码节选与 SHA-256
 124  def read_canonical(path: Path, *, include_buffers: bool = True) -> CanonicalArtifact:
 125      path = path.resolve()
 126      digest = hashlib.sha256()
 127      buffers: dict[str, bytes] = {}
 128      with path.open("rb") as handle:
 129          header_bytes = _read_exact(handle, _FILE_HEADER.size)
 130          digest.update(header_bytes)
 131          magic, major, minor, metadata_length, buffer_count = _FILE_HEADER.unpack(header_bytes)
 132          if magic != MAGIC or (major, minor) != (FORMAT_MAJOR, FORMAT_MINOR):
 133              raise DatasetContractError("unsupported canonical artifact header")
 134          metadata_bytes = _read_exact(handle, metadata_length)
 135          digest.update(metadata_bytes)
 136          try:
 137              metadata = json.loads(metadata_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
 138          except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
 139              raise DatasetContractError("invalid canonical metadata JSON") from error
 140          if canonical_json_bytes(metadata) != metadata_bytes:
 141              raise DatasetContractError("canonical metadata is not canonical JSON")
 142          buffer_descriptors = metadata.get("buffers")
 143          if not isinstance(buffer_descriptors, list):
 144              raise DatasetContractError("canonical metadata lacks buffer descriptors")
 145          if len(buffer_descriptors) != buffer_count:
 146              raise DatasetContractError("canonical header buffer count does not match metadata")
 147          for descriptor in buffer_descriptors:
 148              record_header = _read_exact(handle, _BUFFER_HEADER.size)
 149              digest.update(record_header)

  73  def write_task_plan(path: Path, tasks: tuple[BenchmarkTask, ...]) -> None:
  74      ordered = tuple(sorted(tasks, key=lambda item: item.task_id))
  75      if len({task.task_id for task in ordered}) != len(ordered):
  76          raise ValueError("task plan contains duplicate TaskIDs")
  77      payload = b"".join(canonical_json_bytes(task.to_document()) + b"\n" for task in ordered)
  78      if path.exists():
  79          if path.read_bytes() != payload:
  80              raise FileExistsError("existing task plan differs from deterministic rebuild")
  81          return
  82      path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  83      temporary_name: str | None = None
  84      try:
  85          with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, delete=False) as handle:
  86              temporary_name = handle.name
  87              handle.write(payload)
  88              handle.flush()
  89              os.fsync(handle.fileno())
  90          os.replace(temporary_name, path)
  91          temporary_name = None
  92      finally:
  93          if temporary_name is not None:
  94              Path(temporary_name).unlink(missing_ok=True)

 216  def _conversion(source: str, supported: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[str, bool] | None:
 217      source_dtype = np.dtype(source)
 218      for target in supported:
 219          if source_dtype == np.dtype(target):
 220              return np.dtype(target).str, False
 221      lossless: list[np.dtype[Any]] = []
 222      lossy: list[np.dtype[Any]] = []
 223      for value in supported:
 224          target = np.dtype(value)
 225          if (
 226              source_dtype.kind == target.kind
 227              and source_dtype.kind in "iu"
 228              and target.itemsize >= source_dtype.itemsize
 229          ):
 230              lossless.append(target)
 231          elif source_dtype.kind == target.kind == "f" and target.itemsize >= source_dtype.itemsize:
 232              lossless.append(target)
 233          else:
 234              lossy.append(target)
 235      if lossless:
 236          return min(lossless, key=lambda item: item.itemsize).str, False
 237      if lossy:
 238          return lossy[0].str, True
 239      return None

  52  def apply_compatibility_plan(
  53      array: np.ndarray[Any], plan: CompatibilityPlan, *, channel_index: int = 0
  54  ) -> PreparedInput:
  55      """Apply only the operations already authorized by a CompatibilityPlan.
  56  
  57      This function does not negotiate, sort, fill, interpolate, or select channels.
  58      The independent validator below decides whether the resulting view is valid.
  59      """
  60  
  61      if plan.status is CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED:
  62          raise CodecContractError("an UNSUPPORTED plan cannot be applied")
  63      original_hash = _sha256(array)
  64      current = array
  65      storage: np.ndarray[Any] = current
  66      copied = False
  67      for operation in plan.operations:
  68          if operation.kind in {
  69              AdapterOperationKind.CONTIGUOUS_COPY,
  70              AdapterOperationKind.GATHER_SCATTER,
  71          }:
  72              current = np.ascontiguousarray(current)
  73              storage = current
  74              copied = copied or current is not array
  75          elif operation.kind is AdapterOperationKind.TRANSPOSE_COPY:
  76              if current.ndim < 2:
  77                  current = np.ascontiguousarray(current)

 124  def read_canonical(path: Path, *, include_buffers: bool = True) -> CanonicalArtifact:
 125      path = path.resolve()
 126      digest = hashlib.sha256()
 127      buffers: dict[str, bytes] = {}
 128      with path.open("rb") as handle:
 129          header_bytes = _read_exact(handle, _FILE_HEADER.size)
 130          digest.update(header_bytes)
 131          magic, major, minor, metadata_length, buffer_count = _FILE_HEADER.unpack(header_bytes)
 132          if magic != MAGIC or (major, minor) != (FORMAT_MAJOR, FORMAT_MINOR):
 133              raise DatasetContractError("unsupported canonical artifact header")
 134          metadata_bytes = _read_exact(handle, metadata_length)
 135          digest.update(metadata_bytes)
 136          try:
 137              metadata = json.loads(metadata_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
 138          except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
 139              raise DatasetContractError("invalid canonical metadata JSON") from error
 140          if canonical_json_bytes(metadata) != metadata_bytes:
 141              raise DatasetContractError("canonical metadata is not canonical JSON")
 142          buffer_descriptors = metadata.get("buffers")
 143          if not isinstance(buffer_descriptors, list):
 144              raise DatasetContractError("canonical metadata lacks buffer descriptors")
 145          if len(buffer_descriptors) != buffer_count:
 146              raise DatasetContractError("canonical header buffer count does not match metadata")
 147          for descriptor in buffer_descriptors:
 148              record_header = _read_exact(handle, _BUFFER_HEADER.size)
 149              digest.update(record_header)

只读 ndarray 视图

src/tscompbench/execution/routing.py:15

查看源码节选与 SHA-256
  15  def _array_from_payload(descriptor: dict[str, Any], payload: bytes) -> np.ndarray[Any]:
  16      shape = tuple(int(value) for value in descriptor["shape"])
  17      if descriptor["dtype"] == "bitmap-lsb0":
  18          size = int(np.prod(shape, dtype=np.int64))
  19          array = np.unpackbits(np.frombuffer(payload, dtype=np.uint8), bitorder="little")[:size]
  20          result = array.astype(np.bool_, copy=False).reshape(shape)
  21      else:
  22          dtype = np.dtype(descriptor["dtype"])
  23          expected = int(np.prod(shape, dtype=np.int64)) * dtype.itemsize
  24          if expected != len(payload):
  25              raise ExecutionContractError("canonical payload does not match dtype/shape")
  26          result = np.frombuffer(payload, dtype=dtype).reshape(shape)
  27      result.flags.writeable = False
  28      return result

src/tscompbench/execution/routing.py:31

查看源码节选与 SHA-256
  31  def hash_logical_buffers(buffers: tuple[LogicalBuffer, ...]) -> str:
  32      digest = hashlib.sha256()
  33      for item in buffers:
  34          digest.update(item.name.encode("utf-8"))
  35          digest.update(item.array.dtype.str.encode("ascii"))
  36          digest.update(canonical_json_bytes(list(item.array.shape)))
  37          digest.update(item.array.tobytes(order="C"))
  38      return digest.hexdigest()

  82  def build_boundary_suite(
  83      manifest: CodecManifest, parameters: dict[str, Any]
  84  ) -> tuple[BoundaryCase, ...]:
  85      contract = manifest.document["input"]
  86      minimum = int(contract["min_n"])
  87      maximum = int(contract["max_n"])
  88      block = int(parameters.get("block_size", parameters.get("window_size", max(1, minimum))))
  89      length_candidates = {0, 1, 2, max(0, minimum - 1), minimum, minimum + 1}
  90      length_candidates.update(
  91          {
  92              max(0, block - 1),
  93              block,
  94              block + 1,
  95              max(0, 2 * block - 1),
  96              2 * block,
  97              2 * block + 1,
  98          }
  99      )
 100      length_candidates = {value for value in length_candidates if value <= maximum}
 101      # SYSTEM timestamps and values have separate type roles.
 102      value_dtypes = contract.get("component_dtypes", {}).get("value", contract["dtypes"])
 103      supported_dtypes = tuple(str(item) for item in value_dtypes)
 104      base_dtype = supported_dtypes[0]
 105      cases: list[BoundaryCase] = []
 106      for n in sorted(length_candidates):
 107          expected = "CAPABILITY_REJECTED" if n < minimum else "PASS"

 234  def perform_roundtrip(
 235      adapter: CodecAdapter,
 236      routed: RoutedInput,
 237      parameters: dict[str, Any],
 238      *,
 239      verify_determinism: bool = True,
 240  ) -> RoundTripObservation:
 241      usage_before = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
 242      artifact, encode_wall, encode_cpu, input_immutable, canary_intact = _encode(
 243          adapter, routed, parameters
 244      )
 245      session = adapter.create_session(parameters)
 246      try:
 247          wall_start = time.perf_counter_ns()
 248          cpu_start = time.process_time_ns()
 249          decoded = session.decompress(artifact.stream)
 250          decode_cpu = time.process_time_ns() - cpu_start
 251          decode_wall = time.perf_counter_ns() - wall_start
 252          native_decode = _native_timing(session, parameters)
 253          decoder_telemetry = _codec_telemetry(session)
 254      finally:
 255          session.close()
 256      # The resource sample belongs to this qualification repetition only.  A
 257      # deterministic re-encode is a validation probe, not part of its measured
 258      # encode/decode resource observation.

12 / 运行框架

隔离进程、资源上限与错误传播

隔离针对每次具体函数调用；预检阶段、边界、预热、正式重复、查询及 streaming 都可分别创建 worker。正式任务在父进程 for 循环中逐个执行。

01

父进程调用

run_isolated
  • timeout_seconds 必须 >0；接收函数、args/kwargs、memory_limit 与 affinity。
  • 返回 IsolatedCallResult 状态 / 值 / exception / message / trace / exit_code。

src/tscompbench/execution/isolation.py:65

查看源码节选与 SHA-256
  65  def run_isolated(
  66      function: Callable[..., Any],
  67      *args: Any,
  68      timeout_seconds: float,
  69      memory_limit_bytes: int | None = None,
  70      cpu_affinity: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
  71      **kwargs: Any,
  72  ) -> IsolatedCallResult:
  73      if timeout_seconds <= 0:
  74          raise ValueError("timeout_seconds must be positive")
  75      context = mp.get_context("fork" if "fork" in mp.get_all_start_methods() else "spawn")
  76      parent, child = context.Pipe(duplex=False)
  77      process = context.Process(
  78          target=_child,
  79          args=(child, function, args, kwargs, memory_limit_bytes, cpu_affinity),
  80          daemon=False,
  81      )
  82      process.start()
  83      child.close()
  84      try:
  85          if parent.poll(timeout_seconds):
  86              status, value, exception_type, message, trace, method = parent.recv()
  87              process.join(timeout=1)
  88              return IsolatedCallResult(
  89                  RunStatus(status), value, exception_type, message, trace, process.exitcode, method
  90              )

src/tscompbench/execution/isolation.py:34

查看源码节选与 SHA-256
  34  def _child(
  35      connection: Any,
  36      function: Callable[..., Any],
  37      args: tuple[Any, ...],
  38      kwargs: dict[str, Any],
  39      memory_limit_bytes: int | None,
  40      cpu_affinity: tuple[int, ...] | None,
  41  ) -> None:
  42      method = "NOT_APPLIED"
  43      try:
  44          if cpu_affinity and hasattr(os, "sched_setaffinity"):
  45              os.sched_setaffinity(0, set(cpu_affinity))
  46          if memory_limit_bytes is not None:
  47              current_virtual = _virtual_memory_bytes()
  48              effective = max(memory_limit_bytes, current_virtual + 64 * 1024**2)
  49              resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (effective, effective))
  50              method = "RLIMIT_AS_WITH_EXISTING_VM_HEADROOM"
  51          value = function(*args, **kwargs)
  52          connection.send(("PASS", value, None, None, None, method))
  53      except MemoryError as error:
  54          connection.send(
  55              ("OOM", None, type(error).__name__, str(error), traceback.format_exc(), method)
  56          )
  57      except BaseException as error:
  58          connection.send(
  59              ("CRASHED", None, type(error).__name__, str(error), traceback.format_exc(), method)

src/tscompbench/execution/orchestrator.py:74

查看源码节选与 SHA-256
  74  def _worker_failure_status(
  75      status: RunStatus, exception_type: str | None, message: str | None
  76  ) -> RunStatus:
  77      if exception_type == "OutputCapacityError":
  78          return RunStatus.HARNESS_CAPACITY_ERROR
  79      if exception_type == "MemoryError":
  80          return RunStatus.OOM

 167      adapter: CodecAdapter,
 168      routed: RoutedInput,
 169      parameters: dict[str, Any],
 170      *,
 171      capacity_override: int | None = None,
 172  ) -> tuple[EncodedArtifact, int, int, bool, bool]:
 173      session = adapter.create_session(parameters)
 174      try:
 175          bound = session.output_bound(routed)
 176          if not isinstance(bound, int) or isinstance(bound, bool) or bound < 0:
 177              raise ExecutionContractError("output_bound must return a non-negative integer")
 178          capacity = bound if capacity_override is None else capacity_override
 179          if capacity < 0:
 180              raise ExecutionContractError("output capacity cannot be negative")
 181          storage = bytearray(capacity + len(_CANARY))
 182          storage[capacity:] = _CANARY
 183          before = hash_logical_buffers(routed.buffers)
 184          pairing_before = hash_reference_array(routed.timestamp_reference)
 185          wall_start = time.perf_counter_ns()
 186          cpu_start = time.process_time_ns()
 187          try:
 188              updated = session.compress_update(routed, memoryview(storage)[:capacity])
 189          except SourceDomainError as error:
 190              if (
 191                  before != hash_logical_buffers(routed.buffers)

 382  def perform_measured_roundtrip(
 383      adapter: CodecAdapter,
 384      routed: RoutedInput,
 385      compatibility: CompatibilityPlan,
 386      parameters: dict[str, Any],

 388  ) -> MeasuredRoundTripObservation:

 390

 392      iteration supplies the correctness/accounting evidence; deterministic adapters are
 393      also checked across all streams produced inside this same formal repetition.

 399          )

 401      sampler = ResourceSampler(
 402          requested_scope=policy.resource_scope,
 403          memory_accounting_scope=policy.memory_accounting_scope,
 404          counter_method=policy.counter_method,
 405          energy_method=policy.energy_method,
 406          allocated_logical_cpus=policy.threads * policy.processes,

src/tscompbench/execution/repetition.py:322

查看源码节选与 SHA-256
 322  def _measure_reverse_adapter(
 323      original: RoutedInput,
 324      decoded: DecodedOutput,
 325      compatibility: CompatibilityPlan,
 326  ) -> None:
 327      """Materialize declared inverse adapter work without changing validation evidence."""
 328  
 329      by_name = decoded.by_name()
 330      for expected in original.buffers:
 331          current = by_name[expected.name].array
 332          for operation in reversed(compatibility.operations):
 333              kind = operation.kind.value
 334              if kind == "TRANSPOSE_COPY" and current.ndim >= 2:
 335                  current = current.T
 336              elif kind == "ENDIANNESS_CONVERSION":
 337                  current = current.byteswap().view(current.dtype.newbyteorder())
 338              elif kind in {"EXACT_WIDEN", "LOSSY_CAST"}:
 339                  current = current.astype(expected.array.dtype, copy=False)
 340          # A consumer-visible scalar read prevents a lazy backend from deferring work.
 341          if current.size:
 342              current.reshape(-1)[-1].item()
SHA-256 9a9b4733255b6804df10b31c5b5358434b69de272c203e0a3b16932e33d75e54

 345  def perform_warmup(

 355          )

 365          count += 1

  67  def validate_stage_snapshot(
  68      snapshot: dict[str, Any], *, executor_id: str = EXECUTOR_ID
  69  ) -> dict[str, Any]:
  70      """Validate each forward representation/inverse without using its implementation."""
  71      original = snapshot["original"]
  72      a, b, c = snapshot["A"], snapshot["B"], snapshot["C"]
  73      flags = snapshot["flags"]
  74      seed = snapshot["seed"]
  75      if flags["stage_a"]:
  76          expected = []
  77          for previous, current in zip(original[:-1], original[1:], strict=True):
  78              delta = int(current) - int(previous)
  79              if not -(1 << 63) <= delta < (1 << 63):
  80                  raise PreprocessContractError("stage A accepted checked int64 overflow")
  81              expected.append((delta << 1) ^ (delta >> 63))
  82          expected_a = np.array(expected, dtype="<u8")
  83          if seed != (int(original[0]) if original.size else 0):
  84              raise PreprocessContractError("stage A seed does not preserve original epoch")
  85      else:
  86          expected_a = original.view("<u8")
  87          if seed != 0:
  88              raise PreprocessContractError("disabled stage A seed must be zero")
  89      if a.dtype.str != "<u8" or a.tobytes() != expected_a.tobytes():
  90          raise PreprocessContractError("stage A mathematical oracle mismatch")
  91      expected_b = np.array(
  92          [limb for value in expected_a for limb in (int(value) & 0xFFFFFFFF, int(value) >> 32)],

  89          raise PreprocessContractError("SIMDComp stage D truncated prefix")
  90      magic, length, digest = prefix.unpack_from(stream)
  91      header = stream[prefix.size : prefix.size + length]
  92      if (
  93          magic != b"TSCBSCP1"
  94          or length > 4096
  95          or len(header) != length

  97      ):
  98          raise PreprocessContractError("SIMDComp stage D descriptor framing")

  34  def _restore_adapter_view(
  35      original: np.ndarray[Any], decoded: np.ndarray[Any], plan: CompatibilityPlan
  36  ) -> np.ndarray[Any]:
  37      result = decoded
  38      for operation in reversed(plan.operations):
  39          if operation.kind is AdapterOperationKind.TRANSPOSE_COPY and result.ndim >= 2:
  40              result = result.T
  41          elif operation.kind is AdapterOperationKind.ENDIANNESS_CONVERSION:
  42              result = result.byteswap().view(result.dtype.newbyteorder())

查看源码节选与 SHA-256
 309  def build_query_workload(
 310      *, n: int, m: int, seed: int, query_count: int
 311  ) -> tuple[QueryRequest, ...]:
 312      """Pre-generate the standard point/range × projection matrix outside timers."""
 313  
 314      if n < 0 or m < 0 or query_count < 1:
 315          raise ValueError("query dimensions/count are invalid")
 316      if n == 0 or m == 0:
 317          return ()
 318      rng = random.Random(seed)
 319      lengths = tuple(dict.fromkeys(min(n, value) for value in (1, 16, 100, 1000, n)))
 320      widths = tuple(dict.fromkeys(min(m, value) for value in (1, 2, 4, 8, m)))
 321      matrix = [(length, width) for length in lengths for width in widths]
 322      requests: list[QueryRequest] = []
 323      for index in range(max(query_count, len(matrix))):
 324          length, width = matrix[index % len(matrix)]
 325          start = rng.randrange(0, n - length + 1)
 326          channels = tuple(sorted(rng.sample(range(m), width)))
 327          requests.append(QueryRequest(start, length, channels))
 328      return tuple(requests)

  58  def execute_query_workload(
  59      *,
  60      adapter: Any,

  64      requests: tuple[QueryRequest, ...],

  66      index_bits: int,

  68      """Run a pre-generated query set and verify every returned logical slice.
  69  
  70      Query generation is intentionally a separate call and therefore cannot enter the
  71      latency timer. An adapter session must expose ``query(stream, request)`` and return
  72      ``QueryResult``; full-decode wrappers cannot claim random-access support silently.
  73      """
  74  
  75      session = adapter.create_session(parameters)
  76      query = getattr(session, "query", None)
  77      if not callable(query):
  78          session.close()
  79          raise TypeError("query-capable manifest requires session.query")
  80      value_buffers = tuple(item for item in routed.buffers if str(item.name).startswith("value/"))
  81      if not value_buffers:
  82          value_buffers = tuple(item for item in routed.buffers if str(item.name) == "timestamp")
  83      latencies: list[int] = []

  • create_stream_session；stream_start → 多次 stream_push → stream_finalize。

src/tscompbench/measurement/workloads.py:161

查看源码节选与 SHA-256
 161  def execute_streaming_workload(
 162      *,
 163      adapter: Any,
 164      parameters: dict[str, Any],
 165      routed: Any,
 166      compatibility: Any,
 167      block_size: int,
 168  ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 169      """Drive an explicit streaming session and verify the finalized reconstruction."""
 170  
 171      if block_size < 1:
 172          raise ValueError("streaming block_size must be positive")
 173      create = getattr(adapter, "create_stream_session", None)
 174      if not callable(create):
 175          raise TypeError("streaming-capable manifest requires create_stream_session")
 176      create_started = time.perf_counter_ns()
 177      session = create(parameters)
 178      reset_overhead_ns = time.perf_counter_ns() - create_started
 179      start = getattr(session, "stream_start", None)
 180      push = getattr(session, "stream_push", None)
 181      finalize = getattr(session, "stream_finalize", None)
 182      decompress = getattr(session, "stream_decompress", None)
 183      accounting = getattr(session, "stream_accounting", None)
 184      if not all(callable(item) for item in (start, push, finalize, decompress, accounting)):
 185          session.close()
 186          raise TypeError("streaming session is missing a required lifecycle method")

 465      """Recover the flat projection from authoritative append-only JSONL evidence."""

  15  def append_event(path: Path, event_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
  16      path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  17      event = {
  18          "timestamp_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
  19          "event_type": event_type,
  20          "payload": payload,
  21      }
  22      encoded = (
  23          json.dumps(
  24              event,
  25              ensure_ascii=False,
  26              allow_nan=False,
  27              sort_keys=True,
  28              separators=(",", ":"),
  29          )
  30          + "\n"
  31      ).encode("utf-8")
  32      descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND, 0o644)
  33      try:
  34          fcntl.flock(descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
  35          written = os.write(descriptor, encoded)
  36          if written != len(encoded):
  37              raise OSError("short append-only event write")
  38          os.fsync(descriptor)
  39      finally:
  40          fcntl.flock(descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_UN)

 548  def _layer3_progress(run_path: Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
 549      path = run_path / "run_components.jsonl"
 550      if not path.is_file():
 551          return {}
 552      progress: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
 553      with path.open("rb") as handle:
 554          for line_number, line in enumerate(handle, start=1):
 555              if not line.endswith(b"\n"):
 556                  raise RunnerError(f"run_components line {line_number} is incomplete")
 557              try:
 558                  document = json.loads(line)
 559              except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
 560                  raise RunnerError(f"run_components line {line_number} is invalid") from error
 561              task = progress.setdefault(
 562                  str(document["task_id"]), {"diagnostic": False, "repetitions": set()}
 563              )
 564              if document.get("record_kind") == "DIAGNOSTIC":
 565                  task["diagnostic"] = True
 566              elif document.get("record_kind") == "FORMAL_REPETITION":
 567                  task["repetitions"].add(int(document["repetition_index"]))
 568      return progress

 754  def report_run_set(run_set: RunSet) -> ReportResult:
 755      """Run Layer 5 over frozen Layer 1-4 evidence without invoking a codec."""
 756  
 757      lock_path = run_set.path.parent / ".locks" / f"{run_set.run_set_id}.lock"
 758      lock_descriptor = os.open(lock_path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT, 0o644)
 759      try:
 760          try:
 761              fcntl.flock(lock_descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 762          except BlockingIOError as error:
 763              raise RunnerError(
 764                  f"run set is locked by another process: {run_set.run_set_id}"
 765              ) from error
 766          append_event(
 767              run_set.path / "events.jsonl",
 768              "LAYER_5_REPORTING_STARTED",
 769              {"reporting_policy": run_set.config.reporting.as_document()},
 770          )
 771          result = generate_report(run_set.path, run_set.config.reporting.as_document())
 772          append_event(
 773              run_set.path / "events.jsonl",
 774              "LAYER_5_COMPLETED",
 775              {
 776                  "report_id": result.report_id,

 778                  "summary_count": result.summary_count,

  98  class CodecRegistry:
  99      def __init__(self, root: Path, sources: SourceRegistry):
 100          self.root = root.resolve()
 101          self.sources = sources
 102          self._manifests: dict[str, CodecManifest] = {}
 103          for path in sorted(self.root.glob("*.json")):
 104              if path.name.endswith("classification_rules.json"):
 105                  continue
 106              manifest = self._load(path)
 107              if manifest.key in self._manifests:
 108                  raise CodecContractError(f"duplicate codec key: {manifest.key}")
 109              self._manifests[manifest.key] = manifest
 110          self._aliases: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
 111          for path in sorted((self.root / "aliases").glob("*.json")):
 112              try:
 113                  document = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 114              except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
 115                  raise CodecContractError(f"cannot read codec alias {path}: {error}") from error
 116              _require_keys(
 117                  document,
 118                  required={
 119                      "schema_version",
 120                      "key",
 121                      "canonical_key",
 122                      "canonical_algorithm_id",
 123                      "source_artifact_id",
